Jaimie is a **Private Client Specialist at UWIB Risk & Insurance Solutions**, bringing a strong background in the insurance industry and customer service. As a California native rooted in the Central Valley, she has a genuine appreciation for the communities and people she serves.

Jaimie takes great pride in getting to know her clients personally and understanding what matters most to them. She believes insurance is about more than simply having the right coverage; it’s about building trusted relationships, listening to each client’s unique needs, and helping them make informed decisions that are truly in their best interest. She is committed to providing personalized service and ensuring her clients feel confident and well cared for.

Outside of work, she is happily married and enjoys spending time with her three fur babies, Macie, Mochi, and Stella. She loves music, traveling, and cooking, and especially enjoys making memories with her family and the people she loves.
